$comment: The harness catalog. The harness skill reads it to suggest modules; tasks/apply.mjs reads it to install them. A module's `files`, `rules` and `skills` are copied whole from library/ (laid out like a project) to the same path in the project; `{port}`, `{css}` and `{srcDirs}` in `files` take the stack's values. Its `templates` are configs in template/ that Copier renders per stack and merges with the project's edits; copier.yml `_exclude` leaves out those of unselected modules. `stackDevDependencies` adds packages for one stack only.

core.describe: Claude Code hooks, structure and feature-workflow rules, improve-harness skill, typecheck, ESLint and Prettier on every edit and turn.

lint:file.describe: ESLint on one file (used by the edit hook)

format:file.describe: Prettier on one file (used by the edit hook)

check.describe: all checks at once, as the Stop hook runs them

prepare.describe: turns on the git hooks in .githooks/ (npm runs it on install)

rules.structure.md: where new and moved files go.
rules.feature-workflow.md: the steps for building a user-facing feature.

skills.improve-harness: end of a feature, or when a hook, rule or skill misbehaved: find harness problems and fix the approved ones.

sections.Several agents at once:
- Several agents may work in this repo at the same time, all on `main`. Changes you did not make are another agent's work in progress, not a mess to clean up.
- Touch only your own changes. Never revert, reformat, stash or commit another agent's files.
- Before editing a file, check `git status`. If it has changes you did not make, tell the user which file and wait instead of editing it.
- If the end-of-turn checks fail, first make sure none of the failures come from your own changes. If they all sit in another agent's files, finish with one short line saying so; do not analyse, list or fix them.
- Commit only your own files (`git add <paths>`, never `git add -A`).

rules.tests-e2e.md: end-to-end test conventions (loads when working in `tests/`).

skills.playwright-cli: drive the browser, check a feature, write end-to-end tests.

githooks.pre-push: runs `npm run verify`; the push is cancelled if it fails.

commitlint.describe: Conventional Commits checked by commitlint in a commit-msg hook, plus the skill that writes valid messages.

githooks.commit-msg: checks the commit message with commitlint.

sections.Commits: Before every commit, use the `committing-with-commitlint` skill.

quality.describe: knip (unused files, exports, dependencies) and jscpd (duplicated code), run at the end of every turn.

skills.web-design-guidelines: review UI against the Web Interface Guidelines.
